welcome.title: Welcome to Mault
welcome.content: Let's take a quick tour of scanning, collections, and sorting rules. You can skip anytime and restart it later from Settings.

connectCamera.title: Connect a camera
connectCamera.content: Click Camera on the scanner panel to connect the webcam over your sorter, or pair your phone as a camera. The dot turns green once it's connected.

connectDevice.content: Click Sorter to connect your card sorter over USB, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. Once it's connected, the same menu toggles auto-feed and duplicates, calibrates or clears the sorter, and retries the connection.

switchSorters.title: Switch between sorters
switchSorters.content: Every connected sorter gets its own scanner, and the ones you aren't looking at keep sorting. Pick a sorter here, open All sorters for a live overview, or connect another one.

manageCollections.title: Manage your collections
manageCollections.content: Scans save to the collection shown here. Switch collections from this menu, or use it to copy a share link, open the full collections manager, or create a new collection.

pickRulePreset.title: Pick a rule preset
pickRulePreset.content: The preset shown here decides which bin each scan lands in. Open this menu to switch presets, create or rename one, jump to its sorting rules, or print a control card that switches presets right from the sorter.

filterStats.title: Filter by clicking stats
filterStats.content: Below the scanner, this panel totals up value, rarity, color, and set once you've scanned some cards. Click any rarity, color, or set entry to filter the card grid down to just those cards.

exportCollection.title: Export a collection
exportCollection.content: Open this menu and choose Export to save your scanned cards as CSV, Manabox, Moxfield, TCGplayer, or Card Kingdom files. It also selects or clears cards in bulk.

createCollection.title: Create a collection
createCollection.content: Collections keep separate scan histories, one per game, box, or project. Click here to start a new one.

editCollection.title: Edit a collection
editCollection.content: Rename a collection or adjust its match threshold at any time from here.

editSortingRules.title: Edit sorting rules
editSortingRules.content: Select a bin on the left, then add conditions here (by rarity, color, price, and more) to control which cards land in it. Don't forget to keep one bin marked as the catch-all for anything that doesn't match a rule.

done.title: You're all set!
done.content: That's the tour. You can restart it anytime from Settings > Guided tour.

welcome.title: Sorting logic, in depth
welcome.content: Let's walk through how to build the rules that decide which bin each scanned card lands in. Skip anytime. You can replay this from the same help icon.

sets.title: Rule presets
sets.content: Sorting rules are grouped into named presets for each game, so you can save several sorting strategies and switch between them. Open this menu to create a new preset.

selectBin.title: Select a bin
selectBin.content: Each numbered bin maps to a physical slot on your sorter. Click a bin here to edit the rules that decide what lands in it.

catchAll.title: Set a catch-all
catchAll.content: Exactly one bin should be the catch-all. It receives any card that doesn't match another bin's rules. Toggle it on here.

autoAssign.title: Or let it auto-detect
autoAssign.content: Instead of writing rules by hand, turn on auto-detect and pick a field. The first time a new value for that field shows up, it claims the next open bin automatically. Repeats route back, and once every bin is taken, new values fall to the catch-all. Reset it anytime from here or the quick reset button on the scan page.

combinator.title: AND vs OR
combinator.content: Choose whether a card must match ALL of this group's conditions (AND) or ANY of them (OR).

addCondition.title: Add a condition
addCondition.content: A condition matches a field, rarity, color, price, and more, against an operator and a value. Click here to add one.

conditionRow.title: Build the condition
conditionRow.content: Pick the field to match on the left, an operator, then the value(s) to compare against.

addGroup.title: Nest a group
addGroup.content: For more advanced logic, add a nested group with its own AND/OR combinator, useful for rules like "(rarity is mythic OR rare) AND price > $5".

save.content: Rules aren't applied until you save. Click here once you're happy with this bin's setup.

done.title: That's sorting logic!
done.content: Repeat this for each bin, and don't forget your catch-all. Replay this tour anytime from the help icon on this page.

welcome.title: Building repacks
welcome.content: Let's walk through how Build repacks fills multiple packs at once from the same set of slots. Skip anytime and replay this from the same help icon.

toggle.title: Turn it on here
toggle.content: Choose Build repacks under Sorting mode to turn it on. While it's selected, every bin except the catch-all builds its own pack from the slots below instead of using individual rules.

duplicates.title: Duplicate cards
duplicates.content: Choose what a pack can't have twice: the same printing, the same name (any printing of a card), or the same value of one of the game's fields. A duplicate is skipped for that bin, but can still start a different bin's pack that doesn't have it yet.

slots.title: Define what goes in a pack
slots.content: Each slot pairs a rule (by rarity, color, price, and more) with how many matching cards a pack needs. A pack is complete once every slot hits its count.

addSlot.title: Add more slots
addSlot.content: Click here to add another slot, e.g. one for commons, one for rares - build up the full recipe for a pack.

save.content: Slots aren't applied until you save. Every non-catch-all bin picks these same slots up immediately after.

done.title: That's building repacks!
done.content: Scan as usual - cards route into whichever bin still has room for them, and a bin that fills up just stops accepting cards until you empty it. Replay this tour anytime from the help icon on this page.

welcome.title: Calibrating your sorter
welcome.content: Let's walk through connecting your sorter and dialing in each servo. Skip anytime. You can replay this from the same help icon.

sections.title: Five steps
sections.content: Setting up a sorter goes in order: Connection, Layout, Servos & feeder, Camera, then Test. Switch between the steps here.

connect.content: Pair the sorter over USB here first. Most of this page is disabled until it's connected. Run Test to sample every servo once you're calibrated.

moduleCount.title: Module count
moduleCount.content: Set how many sorting modules are physically installed. This determines how many bins are available.

binConfigurations.title: Bin configurations
binConfigurations.content: Map each numbered bin to a module and direction (left, right, or bottom) so the firmware knows where to send a card, and pick a size (Small, Medium, or Large) so the app can tell when it's full.

irSensor.title: IR sensors
irSensor.content: Read or monitor each module's IR sensor to confirm it detects a card passing through, and check whether the feeder hopper has cards loaded.

binRoutingControls.title: Test your routing
binRoutingControls.content: Feed a single card, run a sample across every bin, or send a card to one specific bin to confirm the routing and timing feel right.

scanRegion.title: Frame the scan region
scanRegion.content: Drag and resize this box to match where a card sits under your camera, so captures crop tightly to just the card.

feeder.title: Feeder calibration
feeder.content: Tune the feeder servo's speed, timeout, pulse, and pause here, then use Set to save each value once it feeds reliably.

moduleCalibration.title: Servo calibration
moduleCalibration.content: For each module, jog the bottom, paddle, and pusher servos to their open/closed (or left/neutral/right) positions and save them. This is what makes routing land cards accurately.

done.title: That's calibration!
done.content: Repeat servo calibration for every module you add. Replay this tour anytime from the help icon on this page.

welcome.title: Welcome to Buy & sell
welcome.content: This is where you run your store. Buy cards from customers, pick and ship orders, hold cards for customers, print price labels and track your sales. Skip anytime and replay this from the help icon.

now.title: Right now
now.content: These tiles show what is open today: buys, picks and reservations. Click a tile to jump to that page.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.content: Your next jobs show up here, like picks ready to complete or cards waiting to be pulled. Click one to go straight to it.

charts.title: Sales and reservations
charts.content: See how much you sold over the last weeks and how reservations are moving.

sections.title: Every part of the store
sections.content: Each card opens one area: Buys, Picks, Reservations, Labels and Sales. Open buys and picks are listed right here.

views.title: Staff and accuracy
views.content: Switch tabs to see what each team member did and how accurate your scans are.

nav.title: Always one click away
nav.content: The Buy & sell pages are also in the sidebar, so you can switch between them from anywhere.

newBuy.title: Start a new buy
newBuy.content: Start a buy when a customer or vendor sells you cards, or when you open a sealed product. Pick the collection, and every card you scan goes straight into it.

list.title: Your buys
list.content: Search your buys or filter them by status to find open, finished or cancelled ones.

unmoved.title: Move cards into stock
unmoved.content: These finished buys still have cards in their buy collection. Move them into your stock when you are ready.

stats.title: The live offer
stats.content: While a buy is open, the offer updates from your buylist as you add cards. An opened product has no offer: you enter what the product cost when you finish it.

cards.title: Every card in the buy
cards.content: Open a card to change its offer. Cards worth less than your minimum get no offer, and you can remove them in one click.

finish.title: Finish the buy
finish.content: Finish when you pay the customer. The price you paid is saved as the cost of each card, and the cards move to storage if you chose a location.

performance.title: How the buy did
performance.content: For finished buys, see what the cards have earned so far compared with what you paid.

welcome.title: Picking orders
welcome.content: A pick is a list of cards to pull for an order. Mault finds the cards in your stock and tells you where each one is.

import.title: Add a pick
import.content: Paste a decklist or import an order to create a pick.

list.title: Your picks
list.content: Filter picks by status. Tick several picks to pull them together in one walk with Pick together.

views.title: Choose how to pick
views.content: Guided walks you through each card. You can also see all cards, go one at a time, work box by box or split the cards by order.

phone.title: Pick on your phone
phone.content: Scan the code with your phone to take the pick with you. Ticks are saved on both devices.

complete.title: Complete the pick
complete.content: Once every card is ticked, complete the pick. The cards leave your stock and the sale is recorded.

welcome.title: Card reservations
welcome.content: Customers can reserve cards from your shop catalog. You hold the cards for them until they pick them up.

lists.title: Open and history
lists.content: Open shows the reservations you still need to handle. History shows the ones that are done.

stages.title: Where each request is
stages.content: Requests are grouped by stage: ready for pickup, to pull, being picked, and in line behind another customer.

createPick.title: Pull the cards
createPick.content: Create a pick to pull reserved cards from your stock. When the pick is complete, the cards are ready for pickup.

actions.title: Hand over or release
actions.content: Mark cards as picked up when the customer collects them. This records the sale at the price shown when they reserved. Release the cards if the customer no longer wants them.

source.title: Choose your cards
source.content: Print labels for a collection, a storage location or a buy.

prices.title: The price on each label
prices.content: Labels show each card's sell price. Change your margin and rounding in Settings > Pricing, or set prices on selected cards with Set prices.

sheet.title: Pick your label sheet
sheet.content: Choose the label sheet you print on and where on the sheet to start, so you can use a sheet that is partly used.

cards.title: Adjust single cards
cards.content: Untick cards you don't want a label for, or type a custom price for one card. Custom prices only apply to this print.

print.title: Print
print.content: When the preview looks right, print the labels.

welcome.title: Your sales
welcome.content: Every card you sell through a pick or a reservation shows up here.

filters.title: Pick a date range
filters.content: Choose the dates to report on. When you open sales from a buy, the report only shows cards from that buy.

totals.title: Totals
totals.content: See revenue, the cost of what you sold, profit and margin. Profit only counts sales where you know what the card cost.

table.title: Every sale
table.content: Each row is one card sold, with its price and, if known, its cost.

export.title: Export
export.content: Download the report as a CSV file for your bookkeeping.

scannerBuy.triggerTooltip: How buying on the scanner works

start.title: Buy cards while you scan
start.content: Start a buy right here to buy cards from a customer without leaving the scanner.

menu.title: Or start from the collection menu
menu.content: You can also start a buy from the collection menu at any time.

scan.title: Scan as usual
scan.content: While a buy is open, every card you scan goes into it.

totals.title: Running totals
totals.content: Watch the card count and the offer grow as you scan. If cards are worth less than your minimum, remove them in one click.

recent.title: Recent cards
recent.content: See the last cards you scanned with their offers, and change an offer for a single card.

filter.title: Show only this buy
filter.content: Turn on Only this buy in the view options to see just the cards from this buy in the grid.

finish.title: Finish the buy
finish.content: Finish the buy here when you pay the customer, without leaving the scanner.
